faq.q: Which airport should I use for Andaz Costa Rica?
faq.a: Guanacaste Airport (LIR) is the closest practical international airport. Private transportation can be arranged directly to the resort.

faq.q: Can I visit waterfalls and wildlife areas from Andaz?
faq.a: Yes. Full-day private tours can connect the resort with wildlife, rainforest, waterfall and volcano experiences across Guanacaste.

faq.q: Do I need a rental car at Andaz Papagayo?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Travelers who plan to stay at the resort and use organized private tours can often manage the trip with airport transfers and excursion transportation.

faq.q: Where is Andaz Peninsula Papagayo located?
faq.a: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort sits inside the exclusive Peninsula Papagayo in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, on the Pacific coast.

faq.q: How far is Andaz Papagayo from Liberia Airport?
faq.a: About 32 to 40 minutes by private transfer from Guanacaste Airport (LIR), roughly 31.6 km away.

faq.q: Can I book private tours directly from Andaz Papagayo?
faq.a: Yes. Wild Papagayo arranges private tours with direct pickup from Andaz Peninsula Papagayo, including wildlife, waterfall and volcano day trips.

faq.q: What are the best day trips from Andaz Costa Rica?
faq.a: Popular options include the Buena Vista Mega Combo, Hanging Bridges & Sloths Experience and Palo Verde River Boat Tour, along with other private Guanacaste excursions.
